'''Shass''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] businesswoman who was born during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], she joined the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and initially planned to rise through the ranks of the organization. However, when the Federation [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and Shass realized that the Trade Federation was corrupt, she refused to progress any further within the organization. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], she later settled in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Zarra/Legends|Zarra]] on the planet [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], she had established the business [[Zarran Imports and Exports]].
